fix: Return a borrowed-or-owned key so character keys (the common case) do not allocate per key press: `fn platform_menu_key(event: &winit::event::KeyEvent) -> Option<std::borrow::Cow<'_, str>>` with `winit::keyboard::Key::Character(value) if !value.is_empty() => Some(Cow::Borrowed(value.as_str()))` and `winit::keyboard::Key::Named(value) => Some(Cow::Owned(format!("{value:?}")))`. The caller at lib.rs:1687-1689 passes `&key`, which deref-coerces to `&str`, so it needs no change. The Named arm still formats per press; a `match` returning `&'static str` for the handled named keys would remove that too if the menu lookup only needs the known names.
